packageRules.description: One weekly PR with every non-major update. renovate-fixup.yml regenerates bun.lock with the pinned bun, the SDK's generated files and the flake's node-modules hashes, and adds a changeset; Renovate merges it once every check passes, which waits out a Chromium pin roll. It rebases when main moves, so the checks rerun.
One weekly PR with every major update. Majors can break the build, so a person lands it.
Move a catalog range to the new version, as bun's own updates do.

Hold the distro binaries' build container on Debian 12. Its glibc (2.36) is the newest the packaged binaries may need; Debian 13 builds need 2.39+ and fail the debian-12 and ubuntu-22.04 installs. Lift when those targets are dropped.
Temporary: hold zbus on 5.x. zbus 6 removes the blocking API and the async-io feature this workspace is built on, so the move needs its own migration PR. Remove this rule in that PR.

customManagers.description: Bun workspace catalog in the root package.json. Renovate's bun manager does not read catalogs yet (renovatebot/renovate#42909); drop this once it does.
